classification.source_level_rationale: retrospective or analytic: This is a retrospective news report from Swiss Television covering the expulsion of Asians from Uganda in 1972.
classification.resume: A 1972 Swiss TV news report (Rundschau) depicts the expulsion of Asians from Uganda under Idi Amin, including scenes of people queuing at the British embassy, Amin meeting Bokassa, and African shoppers in formerly Asian-owned stores.
